title: Compatible overlap maps act on every realization
statement: Fix categories, functors and a coherent diagram d as in [def-pc-two-open-comparison-diagram]. Let A' be in A, B' in B, E in D, e:SU A' isomorphic to SV B', thetaU:HU A' isomorphic to RU E and thetaV:HV B' isomorphic to RV E. Suppose gammaU inverse at A' followed by SP(thetaU.hom) and tauU at E equals HW(e.hom) followed by gammaV inverse at B', SQ(thetaV.hom) and tauV at E. For every F in C and isomorphisms iU:TU F to A', iV:TV F to B' with alphaU inverse at F followed by SU(iU.hom) and e.hom equal to alphaV inverse at F followed by SV(iV.hom), there exist isomorphisms pU:RU(LF) to RU E and pV:RV(LF) to RV E such that tauU inverse at LF followed by SP(pU.hom) and tauU at E equals tauV inverse at LF followed by SQ(pV.hom) and tauV at E. No global gluing assertion or faithfulness assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 09RF, the compatibility calculation from local identifications; proved abstractly by naturality and associativity.

proof.text: Construct pU by composing betaU at F, HU.mapIso iU and thetaU, and pV by the analogous V composition.

Expand the transported restrictions. Postcompose each coherence equation with gamma inverse; cancel gamma with its inverse. Naturality of gamma inverse moves each local realization map through that comparison.
Substitute the overlap equation for theta, apply HW to the realization equation, and use preservation of composition and associativity to conclude equality.
